_about: A device says what it can receive: the Deluge takes a device definition, in the `deluge` format, written as a file at MIDI_DEVICES/DEFINITION/<vendor>/<device>.xml on its card. The words resource, canSet and mediaTypes are those of the ResourceList of MIDI 2.0 Property Exchange; the path is a list of segments, never a template string.
_note: The write of a file is carried by SysEx on the community firmware 1.3 (DelugeFirmware at 680b93c, GPL-3.0-only). The SysEx frames of that write are not described here: another ticket does it.

_sources.notes: The community firmware reads the definition of a MIDI device from MIDI_DEVICES/DEFINITION/<vendor>/<device>.xml on the card (midi_instrument.cpp, readCCLabelsFromFile).
